lists.printed_count_quote: The ordinary papers, &c., were sent to thirty stations on the East Coast of Scotland, Faroe, and Iceland, as was done in 1881.
lists.columns: asterisks for returns 1879/'80/'81/'82; map no. and station, county; height in ft.; keeper's name (or remark)

lists.printed_count_quote: Printed forms of enquiry and letters of instruction were sent to thirty-six lighthouses and light-vessels on the East Coast of England, and two stations on the Channel Islands,--thirty-eight altogether, against thirty-six in 1881,--and returns have been received from thirty, a result which is very encouraging.
lists.columns: star for returns; station name with L.H./L.V.; keepers' names (blank where no return); no map numbers

lists.printed_count_quote: Schedules, &c., were sent to forty stations, the same number as in previous years.

lists.printed_count_quote: In the spring of 1882 forty schedules were forwarded to the light-keepers, and in the autumn forty-one.
